next:wr:334.hint: 明日雨が降る?ーそうでないといいのですが
next:wr:334.answer: Will it rain tomorrow? — I hope not.
next:wr:334.fullSentence: Will it rain tomorrow? — I hope not.
next:wr:334.explanation: I hope so. ⇔ I hope not.『そうだといいのですが ⇔ そうでないといいのですが』。
next:wr:334.relatedInfo: hopeの否定はI don't hope soではなくI hope notを使う点に注意。

next:wr:336.hint: 彼は来る?ーたぶんそうではないと思う
next:wr:336.answer: Is he coming? — I suppose not.
next:wr:336.fullSentence: Is he coming? — I suppose not.
next:wr:336.explanation: I suppose so. ⇔ I suppose not.『たぶんそうだと思う ⇔ たぶんそうではないと思う』。＝I don't suppose so。
next:wr:336.relatedInfo: hopeと同様、notを使う点に注意。

next:wr:338.hint: クッキーを自由に取って食べてください
next:wr:338.answer: Please help yourself to the cookies.
next:wr:338.fullSentence: Please help yourself to the cookies.
next:wr:338.explanation: help oneself to A『Aを自由に取って食べる(飲む)』。
next:wr:338.relatedInfo: toの後に食べ物・飲み物の名詞が続く。

next:wr:340.hint: 彼女は親切そのものだ
next:wr:340.explanation: kindness itself『親切そのもの』。名詞+itselfで性質を強調する表現。
next:wr:340.relatedInfo: 名詞の直後にitselfを置いて強調する用法。

next:wr:342.hint: この機械は操作が簡単そのものだ
next:wr:342.answer: This machine is simplicity itself to operate.
next:wr:342.fullSentence: This machine is simplicity itself to operate.
next:wr:342.explanation: simplicity itself『簡単そのもの』。名詞+itselfの強調表現。
next:wr:342.relatedInfo: 抽象名詞+itselfで性質を強く強調する。

next:wr:344.hint: 私たちが昨日会った女性は私のおばだ(先行詞が人、目的格)
next:wr:344.answer: The woman whom we met yesterday is my aunt.
next:wr:344.fullSentence: The woman whom we met yesterday is my aunt.
next:wr:344.explanation: 先行詞が「人」の場合の関係代名詞: 主格who・所有格whose・目的格whom(that)。
next:wr:344.relatedInfo: 口語ではwhomの代わりにwhoやthatもよく使われる。

next:wr:346.hint: ここは私が生まれた町だ(場所を表す関係副詞)
next:wr:346.answer: This is the town where I was born.
next:wr:346.fullSentence: This is the town where I was born.
next:wr:346.explanation: 関係副詞: 場所where・時when・理由why・方法how。
next:wr:346.relatedInfo: ＝the town in which I was born。

next:wr:348.hint: 私たちが初めて出会った時のことを今でも覚えている(時を表す先行詞)
next:wr:348.answer: I still remember the time when we first met.
next:wr:348.fullSentence: I still remember the time when we first met.
next:wr:348.explanation: 時を表す先行詞the time+when(関係副詞)。
next:wr:348.relatedInfo: 場所the place+where、理由the reason+whyも同グループ。

next:wr:350.hint: 彼女には自慢の賢い息子がいる
next:wr:350.answer: She has a clever son of whom she is proud.
next:wr:350.fullSentence: She has a clever son of whom she is proud.
next:wr:350.explanation: be proud of A『Aを誇りに思う』のofが前に出た形。前置詞+関係代名詞の語順。
next:wr:350.relatedInfo: She is proud of her son. が元になっている。

next:wr:352.hint: これほど美しい夕日を見たことがない(〜のようなAという表現)
next:wr:352.answer: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset as this.
next:wr:352.fullSentence: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset as this.
next:wr:352.explanation: such A as ~『〜のようなA』。asが疑似関係代名詞として使われる。
next:wr:352.relatedInfo: the same A as ~ 『〜と同じA』と似た構造。

next:wr:354.hint: 例外のない規則はない
next:wr:354.answer: There is no rule but has exceptions.
next:wr:354.fullSentence: There is no rule but has exceptions.
next:wr:354.explanation: There is no A but has B『Bを持たないAはない』。butが疑似関係代名詞(=that ... not)として使われる。
next:wr:354.relatedInfo: There is no rule that does not have exceptions. と同義。

next:wr:356.hint: 必要以上のお金を使うな
next:wr:356.answer: Don't spend more money than is needed.
next:wr:356.fullSentence: Don't spend more money than is needed.
next:wr:356.explanation: than is needed『必要とされる以上に』。疑似関係代名詞thanが主語の代わりを果たす。
next:wr:356.relatedInfo: than節の中で主語が省略され、動詞が直接続く形。

next:wr:358.hint: そういうわけで彼は試験に落ちた
next:wr:358.answer: He didn't study at all. That is why he failed the exam.
next:wr:358.fullSentence: He didn't study at all. That is why he failed the exam.
next:wr:358.explanation: That is why ~『そういうわけで〜』。結果を説明する文。
next:wr:358.relatedInfo: That is because ~(原因を説明)との対比。

next:wr:360.hint: 彼が言ったことを知っている
next:wr:360.explanation: 関係代名詞what『〜すること/もの』(先行詞を含む、後ろは不完全文)。

next:wr:362.hint: 『あの』本は誰のもの?(指示形容詞のthat)
next:wr:362.answer: Whose book is that? — That is mine.
next:wr:362.fullSentence: Whose book is that? — That is mine.
next:wr:362.explanation: thatの4つの品詞の一つ、指示形容詞『あの〜』(名詞の前に置く)。他に指示代名詞・関係代名詞・接続詞の用法がある。
next:wr:362.relatedInfo: 文脈でthatの品詞・用法を見分ける必要がある。

next:wr:364.hint: 最初は簡単に見えるものも、結局は難しいと判明することが多い
next:wr:364.answer: What seems easy at first often turns out to be difficult.
next:wr:364.fullSentence: What seems easy at first often turns out to be difficult.
next:wr:364.explanation: 関係代名詞whatが文の主語になる用法。
next:wr:364.relatedInfo: whatは単数扱いされることが多い。

next:wr:366.hint: これはかつてのそれ(もとの姿)ではない
next:wr:366.answer: This is not what it used to be.
next:wr:366.fullSentence: This is not what it used to be.
next:wr:366.explanation: what it used to be『かつての姿』。慣用的なwhat節。
next:wr:366.relatedInfo: He is not what he used to be.(彼はかつての彼ではない)も同じ形。

next:wr:368.hint: 彼が言うことを信じている(先行詞がなく、後ろの文で名詞が1つ欠落している)
next:wr:368.explanation: 先行詞がなく、後ろに続く文の中で名詞が1つ欠落している(不完全文)ならwhat節。
next:wr:368.relatedInfo: 接続詞thatの後は完全文になる点との対比。

next:wr:370.hint: 私は残しておいた少ないお金を全部あげた
next:wr:370.answer: I gave what little money I had left.
next:wr:370.fullSentence: I gave what little money I had left.
next:wr:370.explanation: what little+名詞『少ないなりの〜全部』。
next:wr:370.relatedInfo: what few+複数名詞も同じ構造で使われる。

next:wr:372.hint: トムが今日あるのは師のおかげだ
next:wr:372.answer: Tom owes what he is to his mentor.
next:wr:372.fullSentence: Tom owes what he is to his mentor.
next:wr:372.explanation: owe what S is to A『Sが今日あるのはAのおかげだ』。
next:wr:372.relatedInfo: what he isは『今の彼』を意味する。

next:wr:374.hint: トムはかつての彼より裕福だ、を正しく表す語は?
next:wr:374.answer: Tom is richer than he used to be.
next:wr:374.fullSentence: Tom is richer than he used to be.
next:wr:374.explanation: 比較のthanの後には関係代名詞whatは使えない(×than what he used to be)。thanは接続詞なのでそのまま完全文が続く。
next:wr:374.relatedInfo: whatを使う誤りは頻出のひっかけポイント。

next:wr:376.hint: 彼は良い友人がいるという点で幸運だ
next:wr:376.answer: He is lucky in that he has good friends.
next:wr:376.fullSentence: He is lucky in that he has good friends.
next:wr:376.relatedInfo: becauseに近い意味で使われることもある。

next:wr:378.hint: 必ずドアに鍵をかけるようにしてください
next:wr:378.answer: Please make sure that you lock the door.
next:wr:378.fullSentence: Please make sure that you lock the door.
next:wr:378.explanation: make sure that SV『SVを確認する/必ずSVするようにする』。
next:wr:378.relatedInfo: 命令文でよく使われる注意喚起の表現。

next:wr:380.hint: もし雨が降らなければ、ピクニックに行く
next:wr:380.answer: Provided it doesn't rain, we'll go on a picnic.
next:wr:380.fullSentence: Provided it doesn't rain, we'll go on a picnic.
next:wr:380.explanation: provided [providing] (that) SV『もしSVならば』。ifに近い意味を持つ接続詞的表現。

next:wr:382.hint: 新しい学校がどのようなものか教えて
next:wr:382.answer: Tell me what your new school is like.
next:wr:382.fullSentence: Tell me what your new school is like.
next:wr:382.explanation: what S is like『Sがどのようなものか』。
next:wr:382.relatedInfo: likeは前置詞で『〜のような』の意味。
